newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Jan unemployment up at 5.14 pct -- IBGE.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Jan unemployment up at 5.14 pct -- IBGE.

text.p: Brazil's January unemployment rate increased to 5.14 percent from 3.82 percent in December, the National Statistics Institute (IBGE) said.
However, the unemployment rate fell in comparison with January 1996 when it stood at 5.26, the IBGE said.
The number of people working increased one percent in January compared to January 1996, with four of the six main urban centers seeing an increase in the number of people employed, the IBGE said.
The number of people employed fell in all of Brazil's six main urban areas from December to January except Rio de Janeiro, where employment rose 0.7 percent.
The biggest job losses took place in the retail and smelting sector, the IBGE said.
((-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
